arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-03-01' AND date < '2019-03-16'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions dated 1 March 2019 through 15 March 2019 inclusive.
assumptions: Date range taken as 2019-03-01 00:00:00 up to but not including 2019-03-16, so both 1 March and 15 March are included.
All transactions are counted, including those with no fraud label and those with negative amounts.
